cells.tense: You are standing in the deep right now with the pen in your hand.
cells.ask: Tell two or three people one pattern you have been keeping to yourself, in plain words — and let how it lands be enough for today.
cells.core:
You are in the deep at your own pace, and you know where the bottom is. That is unusual. Most people either stay shallow or sink. You go down and come back with something nobody else saw, and then you keep going.

Carrying weight is not just bearing it. It is carrying what you find back up so it can be useful. Going well here looks like the return trip happening as easily as the descent. The one thing worth keeping an eye on is that return — coming back is not a failure. When you stall down there too long, staying level starts meaning keeping a door shut instead.
cells.sheetLine: You go deep and come back with something, and you keep your footing.
cells.verb: Going so deep into pattern that the mind reaches its own floor
cells.place: Standing where you hold under weight

cells.tense: You are bracing for a moment ahead that has not arrived yet, and you are already living in it.
cells.ask: Pick one pattern you have already seen clearly and say it plainly to one person who can use it, before you have it polished.
cells.core:
Going well here looks like the deep opening on its own schedule and you waiting for it. What is actually happening is that somewhere ahead is a version where it all finally clicks, and you are already living there, pushing so hard the depth turns into a hurry. You want to get to the bottom before the bottom is ready, and the pushing costs you the thing it was for.

What your endurance is doing is holding a shape you have not finished deciding on. You brace it as if it were certain. It is not the pattern-finding that is failing; it is the timing. Nothing you are seeing is wrong.
cells.sheetLine: You are rushing the bottom instead of letting it come to you.
cells.verb: Going so deep into pattern that the mind reaches its own floor

cells.tense: You stopped at a door that is already behind you, and some part of you is still standing there.
cells.ask: Describe one pattern out loud to someone else this week — badly, briefly, not to fix anything — and notice what comes back without acting on it.
cells.core:
At some point a door was there and now it is behind you, and you have not gone through. Something came back once from the deep and did not land, and since then you have been carrying the weight of keeping it out of other people's hands.

Going well here looks like the descent and the return both still working. The going-down still works. What stopped was the saying-it-out-loud part. That is where your strength is needed, and it does not require reopening anything with anyone. It can be one honest sentence to one person who has no idea you are carrying this at all.
cells.sheetLine: The depth still works. The telling stopped.

cells.tense: You are already shaping how people around you see patterns, and you have not claimed it.
cells.ask: Catch one thing you have explained to someone this week and say, in your own head, that the finding was yours.
cells.core:
You are already in the deep and working from there — in how you frame things, what you connect for people, what you keep level while you do it. But you describe it as if the pattern were doing the finding by itself. You call it just following the question, or just being thorough.

Keeping the floor steady is real. It is the part of you that stays level while you go down and come back. What has not happened is you saying so. Going well here looks like the work counting as yours out loud, at least once. You have not said that the digging into the deep is something you are doing, and work you do not claim gets spent without being counted.
cells.sheetLine: You are already finding the pattern. You just haven't put your name on it.
